mapper.sql: g.id, g.tenant_id, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.status, g.remark, g.create_by, g.create_time, g.create_dept, g.update_by, g.update_time, g.del_flag
mapper.select:
SELECT g.id, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.status, g.remark, g.create_time, g.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_flow_user_group_member m WHERE m.group_id = g.id AND m.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0) AS member_count FROM sys_flow_user_group g
g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.del_flag = 0
AND (g.group_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND g.group_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{groupCode}, '%')
AND g.group_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{groupName}, '%')
AND g.status = #{status}
ORDER BY g.create_time DESC, g.id DESC

SELECT g.id, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.status, g.remark, g.create_time, g.update_time, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_flow_user_group_member m WHERE m.group_id = g.id AND m.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0) AS member_count FROM sys_flow_user_group g WHERE g.id = #{id} AND g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.del_flag = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_flow_user_group SET del_flag = id, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_flow_user_group_member (tenant_id, group_id, user_id, status, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{groupId}, #{userId}, 1, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createDept}, #{operatorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = 1, del_flag = 0, update_by = #{operatorId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, m.status, m.create_time FROM sys_flow_user_group_member m INNER JOIN sys_flow_user_group g ON g.id = m.group_id AND g.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND g.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND u.del_flag = 0 WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY u.real_name ASC, u.id ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT DISTINCT m.user_id FROM sys_flow_user_group g INNER JOIN sys_flow_user_group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id AND m.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.user_id AND u.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND u.user_status = 1 AND u.del_flag = 0 WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.group_code = #{groupCode} AND g.status = 1 AND g.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY m.user_id ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT g.group_code FROM sys_flow_user_group g INNER JOIN sys_flow_user_group_member m ON m.group_id = g.id AND m.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.del_flag = 0 WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND g.status = 1 AND g.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY g.id ASC LIMIT 200
